title: Chapter 147
text:
The Mechanic class was known for its versatility in battle tactics. Just like how Saint Seiya would not be defeated by the same move, the Mechanic class would not only have one battle mode. In order to form a new battle mode, one would need to revolve around the core of the battle mode. For example, the core of the Stealth Sniper Style was the sniper rifle, coupled with the Electromagnetic Hover-boots, special ammunition, stealth abilities, and so on.

For the Mechanic class, to create a new battle mode from scratch was a very difficult but also very interesting thing. Creating all kinds of machinery and perfecting ideas would give one a sense of fulfillment when it was finally completed. It was similar to the experience of a management game.

I have a lot of choices, such as the Ranger, the Foldable Turret, and the self-created mechanical suit. However, the Ranger's attributes and intelligence are not enough, and it is too big to carry around. Furthermore, there is only one model. Even if I force it into a robot army, the effect will not be good, and it is very expensive. As for the Turret … although it has the word 'foldable' in its name, the base plate is not small either. I don't have the speed to assemble it, so I can't form a fire coverage style. I can only use it as a trap …

There is also the self-created mechanical suit … Han Xiao's eyes flashed. He had a lot of blueprints that could be used on armor, such as the K600 endoskeleton, smart chip, exoskeleton limbs, electromagnetic hovering power shoes, basic energy cube, and various modules. Furthermore, he had already learned all the basic knowledge, such as bionics, mechanical dynamics, assembly, energy, and so on. He had met the requirements to create his own armor.

This idea was not bad, but there were some practical problems. For example, if he wanted to wear a mechanical suit, he would first need a logistics vehicle to repair faults and replenish fuel. Otherwise, his ability to fight would be very poor. It was a problem that most men would face …

Furthermore, he did not want to run around wearing a metal can. It would be best if he could fly. He made a jet backpack, but it was still in the testing stage. Once it was activated, the backpack would fly out, but the person would not. If he tied the backpack tightly, he would be able to experience the feeling of a Ferris wheel traveling at a hundred times the speed. Han Xiao felt that he would not want to try it a second time, so other than the small drone, his other machines did not have the ability to fly for the time being.

Medium and large mechanical suits required the advanced knowledge [Heavy Mechanical Modification]. He could only make light mechanical suits. The nano suit was more classic, but it also required the advanced knowledge [Micro Mechanical Modification]. Han Technician suddenly had a flash of inspiration. He had a new idea.

"I almost fell for the wrong idea. Actually, I don't need to use armor as the core of my battle strategy. I can start with the support type of light armor. I don't need to match it with firepower. I can just improve my personal qualities …" He had an idea. The support type of light armor seemed reliable. He remembered many mechas that he had used or seen before. He should be able to replicate it.

As for the robots and turrets, they were not convenient to carry around. They could not possibly bring a truck with them everywhere. Even if they wanted to airdrop support, they would first need a transport plane. Not to mention the fuel costs … You know that the country's airspace is a no-fly zone, right? Even if the Farian Corporation had flight permits, they had to follow the flight route and could not fly anywhere. It was fine to fly in the wilderness, but there was no stable supply station in the wilderness. It would be difficult to use airdrops.

The night gradually faded away, and the sky blossomed with the light of dawn, dyeing the night sky into a grayish-blue color, and gradually brightening up.

Han Xiao twisted his neck, and his cervical vertebrae made cracking sounds. A brand new power flowed through his body, and the rich energy made him feel full of energy. He felt that he could punch a hole in the sky … Of course, this was just an illusion caused by the sudden increase in power. After becoming stronger, his senses were also more sensitive. Han Xiao felt that his vision, hearing, and smell had all improved. He looked into the distance and could see the rough texture of a tree in the distance.

Han Xiao boarded the helicopter and let the pilot take off.

…

After taking the Dark Net helicopter and landing several times for refueling, they arrived at another novice village in the Southern Continent. It was also a rogue settlement called Green Valley Town.

Blue Star had a total of nineteen novice landing sites. Five were in the Southern Continent, four were in the Western Continent, four were in the Northern Continent, and six were in the Andrea Mainland.

Green Valley Town was a settlement controlled by a rogue warlord. It was one of the territories of the Overmera family.

Overmera was a well-known rogue warlord force. It was managed by a family, and its headquarters was in the Northern Continent. It was a partner of Theseus, and it also had a territory in the Southern Continent. The leader was Delot Overmera. Those who had this surname were his direct relatives, and the other leaders were all strong people, such as the second leader Xiao Jin, the third leader Se Qi, and so on. It was a force made up of people from different countries in the old era, and there were all kinds of races.

The warlord forces had various names for themselves, such as "Family", "Group", "Consortium", "General", and so on. The original intention was for the rogue to stick together and not be bullied. Later on, the force grew and became a warlord with armed forces. They had a lot of authority in the wilderness, and many rogues would seek refuge in their territory. After all, the wilderness of Blue Star was not safe.

What he needed to do now was to continue looking for players to gain experience. The time in the early stages was precious, so he did not rest after the battle, and went straight to the novice village to find players.

There were three situations where players could log in, log out, and revive. The first was to revive "on the spot". This required some explanation. If you were in a moving vehicle when you logged out, then you would revive on the vehicle and not at the original geographical location. For example, if you were traveling in space, it would be too bad if you were not in the spaceship when you logged in.

The second was to revive in the nearest city. This was only suitable for reviving, and not for logging in or out. This meant that if you died, you would get a free chance to return to the city.

The third was to bind to a certain revival point. There were some special conditions, such as faction affiliation, special items, and the approval of NPCs. For example, if you joined a secret faction, you could choose to bind to that faction's stronghold as your revival point, but other players could not.

Mad Blade's Angry Sword would go online in the helicopter. Han Xiao left a contact phone and asked the pilot to wait. He then trekked through the forest and headed to Green Valley Town.

Two hours later, the outline of Green Valley Town appeared in the distance. It was located on a plain in the forest, built with fortifications and surrounded by barbed wire. Rogues with guns were patrolling everywhere. Just as Han Xiao had guessed, the players were camping outside the settlement, just like Big Horn Village.

Han Xiao did not hide. The lookout in Green Valley Town saw him from afar and immediately reported to the person in charge of Green Valley Town, Balsas.

Balsas was a bald black man. He was not tall nor strong, but he was short and thin. His pair of triangular eyes made him look very gloomy. When he heard the lookout describe Han Xiao's appearance, he was slightly surprised. "Sounds like Black Phantom."

Balsas took out his laptop and pulled up the picture of Black Phantom's bounty. After getting the confirmation from the lookout, his expression changed. "I heard that he just intervened in the battle of Tedramira River a few days ago. What is he doing here? I don't have anything to do with him. "

Black Phantom's name made Balsas a little afraid. Although there were many armed forces in Green Valley Town, it did not make him feel safe. Balsas pondered and said, "Should I contact him to confirm the purpose of his visit?"

Overmera and Black Phantom did not have anything to do with each other. Balsas felt that there would not be any conflict with Black Phantom, and no one on the Dark Net had put a bounty on him. He calmed down and called an assistant to contact Black Phantom on his behalf. He did not dare to meet Black Phantom personally.

When the assistant walked out of the gate and walked toward Black Phantom, Balsas went to the gate and observed through the barbed wire. He was very careful.

However, Balsas soon saw a scene that surprised him. He saw that the group of refugees who were temporarily staying outside the settlement were very excited about Black Phantom's arrival and surrounded him.

Balsas was very surprised. How did this group of refugees know Black Phantom?

…

There were fewer players in Green Valley Town than in Big Horn Village.

As soon as Han Xiao arrived at the players' camp, he was warmly welcomed. The players all crowded around him. There was a sea of people, and he was completely surrounded.

The incident in Big Horn Village some time ago had spread to the entire Blue Star group through the forum. The other novice villages were very envious of the people in Big Horn Village who could change their profession. Now that they saw Black Phantom unexpectedly appear here, the novice players in Green Valley Town were very excited.

"Black Phantom is here!"

"We are in luck too!"

The players were very excited.
